Cannabis Stocks Recovering Premarket
content.summary: U.S. cannabis stocks were rising in premarket trading after President Donald Trump signed an executive order asking the U.S. government to reclassify the substance as less dangerous.  Investors took profits on the executive order, but some gains recovered premarket.  A basket of cannabis stocks—represented by the AdvisorShares Pure US Cannabis exchange-traded fund—rose 5.7% premarket after closing down 29% Thursday.
